_note: Every ACS data query now requires an API key, so unlike the geometry fixtures
beside this one these values could not be recorded from the live service. The
response *shape* is the documented one and the variable ids are real, read from
the keyless groups endpoint on 2026-09-11; the numbers are synthetic.
'fill' is used for every declared variable a tract does not override, so each
override below is a case a test asserts on rather than scenery. A fill margin of
12 on an estimate of 100 is a coefficient of variation of 0.073, comfortably
under the 0.30 threshold, so the only high-variation estimate in the fixture is
the one put there on purpose.

22033000100._case: a controlled estimate: -555555555 in the margin column means the Bureau fixed the estimate to an independent population total, so its sampling error is zero rather than unknown

22033000200._case: an observed zero: no household in this tract is linguistically isolated, which is a finding and not an absence

22033000300._case: a jam value: -666666666 means the survey could not compute the quantity, so the estimate is absent and must not become a zero

22033000400._case: a high coefficient of variation: 90 / 1.645 / 40 is 1.37, far above 0.30. It is loaded anyway and lowers c_spatial

22075050100._case: a blank cell, and a tract whose population really is zero. Plaquemines tract 501 is 977 square kilometres of land and 1,364 of water

22071000100._case: present in the release with no TIGER geometry, so it has no polygon to reach a hex through and is rejected and counted
